verdict.rationale: telli documents a Live Monitoring view with a real-time call overview, plus metric tracking (reach rate, call duration, success rate) and per-call analysis, which covers the 'monitor live calls' half of the story. Nothing documents alerting on agent misbehavior or error-rate spikes. Call-event webhooks are only a building block a user could wire into their own alerting, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: built-in alerting on agent misbehavior, error-rate spike detection or thresholds, error-rate metrics, and depth on what Live Monitoring shows or any independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can monitor live calls in production and get alerts when agents misbehave or error rates spike

citations.quote: Live Monitoring > Real-time call overview of your contacts
Track key metrics like reach rate, call duration, and success rate.
Analyze individual calls, transcripts, and call outcome fields.
